relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: matriculated at St Petersburg as a law student in 1836

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: and subsequently at Berlin, from 1840 to 1842, where he devoted himself exclusively to studies of Eastern languages

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: On his return to St Petersburg in 1843 he taught classics in the First Grammar School

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: From 1854 until his death he was an extraordinary member of the Imperial Academy.

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.object: Saint Petersburg Roman Catholic Theological Academy
relations.evidence: From 1860 to 1873 he simultaneously held the professorship of classical languages in the Saint Petersburg Roman Catholic Theological Academy.

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: he arranged, completed and brought out in twelve volumes the literary remains of Matthias Alexander Castrén

relations.subject: Franz Anton Schiefner
relations.evidence: in quick succession, from Baron Peter von Uslar's investigations, comprehensive papers on the Avar, Udi, Abkhaz, Chechen, Kasi-Kumuk, and Hyrcanian languages
